evidence_boundary.warning: All permitted years were previously inspected. This is retrospective historical evaluation, not a clean holdout.

common_execution.bar_source: preserved Databento GLBX.MDP3 continuous one-minute OHLCV
common_execution.daily_session: 09:30-15:59 America/New_York RTH aggregated from completed one-minute bars
common_execution.hourly_session: RTH 60-minute bars anchored at 09:30 America/New_York; incomplete final 30-minute candle may be used only as the next entry open, never as a completed signal bar
common_execution.entry_timing: next executable RTH open after a completed close-based signal unless the source explicitly specifies a next-day stop order
common_execution.gap_stop: fill at worse of stop or bar open
common_execution.roll_policy: force exit at the last RTH close before a continuous-contract instrument mapping change; no synthetic roll-gap profit
common_execution.overlap_policy: one open position per candidate/instrument; ignore new entries until flat
common_execution.inference: session-aligned stationary bootstrap, 50,000 resamples, expected block lengths 5/10/20 sessions, BH and BY corrections across all causal candidate variants

candidates.source_rule: After a completed daily candle has a lower high and lower low than the previous candle, place a next-session buy stop at the signal candle high. If triggered, exit that session at the RTH close.
candidates.adaptation: NQ/MNQ RTH daily candles; a gap above the stop fills at the next RTH open; order expires after one session.

candidates.source_rule: ALG01 reversal plus the signal candle must close below its open.
After a completed daily candle has a higher high and higher low than the previous candle, place a next-session buy stop at the signal candle high and exit that session at the RTH close.
candidates.adaptation: Same fill and expiry handling as ALG01_REVERSAL.

candidates.source_rule: Long when close < rolling 10-bar highest high - 2.5 * (25-bar mean high - 25-bar mean low) and IBS=(close-low)/(high-low) < 0.3. Exit after a completed close > the prior day's high.
candidates.adaptation: Source does not state executable fill timing; enter and exit at the next RTH open after each completed close signal.

candidates.source_rule: On hourly bars, ADX > 25 and +DI crosses above -DI; enter long at the next hourly candle open; stop 1 ATR and target 2R.
candidates.adaptation: Wilder ADX/DMI/ATR period 14 because the source does not state a period; carry until stop/target or roll exit.

candidates.source_rule: When hourly ADX crosses above 25, enter long at the next hourly candle open; stop 1.5 ATR and target 3.5R.
candidates.adaptation: Wilder period 14; the source explicitly selected these values after optimization, so they are tested unchanged and counted in the multiple-testing family.

candidates.source_rule: ALG03_ADX_TUNED plus completed hourly close above EMA200.
candidates.adaptation: EMA200 is calculated from completed hourly RTH bars.

candidates.source_rule: Completed daily close above SMA200 and Wilder RSI(2) below 5; enter long next RTH open; after a completed close above SMA5, exit next RTH open.
candidates.adaptation: The source itself replaces its same-close entry with next-day open. Exit is also delayed to next open to preserve causality.

candidates.source_rule: Combine ALG04 long with reversed short: close below SMA200 and RSI(2) above 95; cover after completed close below SMA5.
candidates.adaptation: One position at a time; next-open causal fills.

candidates.source_rule: Source variation: use the ALG04 long entry and exit at that entry session's close (the reported best fixed hold was zero days).
candidates.adaptation: Next-open entry after the signal, scheduled RTH-close exit.

candidates.source_rule: Buy after a daily close below the lower Bollinger band; exit after close above the middle band.
candidates.adaptation: Standard Bollinger 20-period SMA with 2 population standard deviations; next-open causal fills because the source omits fill timing.

candidates.source_rule: ALG05 basic entry plus close above SMA200; exit after close above the Bollinger middle band.
candidates.adaptation: Same Bollinger and causal fill conventions as ALG05_BB_BASIC_MID.

candidates.source_rule: Close below lower Bollinger band while above SMA200; exit after close above upper Bollinger band.
candidates.adaptation: Same Bollinger and causal fill conventions; no stop, matching the source.

candidates.source_rule: If 100*(close-low)/(high-low) < 20 after a completed daily bar, buy at that close and sell at the next daily close.
candidates.adaptation: Primary valid lane enters at the next RTH open and exits that same session's close. A separately labeled noncausal source-literal diagnostic may use the signal close but is never promotion eligible.

non_reproducible_leads.reason: Feature-labeling tutorial, not a complete entry/exit strategy.
Requires individual calendar-spread legs and OU calibration inputs not present in the NQ/MNQ continuous cache.
Requires a point-in-time ETF constituent universe and cross-sectional portfolio data.
Walk-forward methodology post does not provide a complete strategy rule.
Oscillator names, thresholds, filters, stop, and reversal-exit definitions are absent.
